name: @pipeworx/mcp-finnhub

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a real-time stock quote including current price, change, and volume. Example: get_quote({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Finnhub API key (get one free at finnhub.io)

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Get recent news articles about a company within a date range. Returns headline, summary, source, and URL. Example: get_company_news({ symbol: "AAPL", from: "2024-01-01", to: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "your-key" })

from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Get upcoming and recent earnings reports. Pass `symbol` for one company's earnings dates, or omit it for the whole market. Optionally filter by date range. Example: get_earnings_calendar({ symbol: "CRM", from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-06-30", _apiKey: "your-key" })

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. "CRM". Omit for the market-wide calendar.

tools.name: get_earnings_surprises
tools.description: EPS actual vs analyst (consensus) estimate, beat or miss, for a company's recent quarters — the "earnings surprise" history. Returns per quarter: fiscal period, EPS actual, EPS estimate, surprise amount and percent. Revenue is NOT included (Finnhub's earnings-surprise data is EPS-only); for revenue estimates on upcoming quarters, see get_earnings_calendar. Example: get_earnings_surprises({ symbol: "MSFT", limit: 4, _apiKey: "your-key" })

limit.description: Number of most-recent quarters to return (default 4, max 20)

_apiKey.description: Finnhub API key (get one free at finnhub.io)

tools.name: search_symbol
tools.description: Search for stock ticker symbols by company name or keyword. Returns matching symbols with descriptions. Example: search_symbol({ query: "apple", _apiKey: "your-key" })

query.description: Search query — company name or keyword, e.g. "apple", "tesla"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-finnhub forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the finnhub pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
